params.name: email
params.description: Filter donations by the donor's email address.

params.name: date_from
params.description: Filter donations on or after this date. Accepted formats: YYYY-mm-dd, YYYY/mm/dd, YYYYmmdd, dd-mm-YYYY.

params.name: date_to
params.description: Filter donations on or before this date. Accepted formats: YYYY-mm-dd, YYYY/mm/dd, YYYYmmdd, dd-mm-YYYY.

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: Filter donations by Donorbox campaign id.

params.name: id
params.description: Filter to a single donation by its Donorbox donation id.

params.name: first_name
params.description: Filter donations by donor first name.

params.name: last_name
params.description: Filter donations by donor last name.

params.name: donor_id
params.description: Filter donations by Donorbox donor id.

params.name: amount[usd][min]
params.description: Minimum donation amount (USD), usable alone or with amount[usd][max].

params.name: amount[usd][max]
params.description: Maximum donation amount (USD), usable alone or with amount[usd][min].

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of records per page. Default 50, maximum 100 (values above 100 fall back to the default).

items.docs: Returns all donations for the authenticated organization, including Stripe and PayPal transactions, donor detail, and any custom question/answer fields collected on the donation form. Endpoint and response shape confirmed in the official README sample payloads.
